attempts.summary: Configured persistent NFSv4 sharing from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. The dataops identity is UID/GID 4500 on both nodes, the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770, and bidirectional files retain 4500:4500 ownership. Both nodes were rebooted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1 were preserved.
